title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Cool Menthol
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Cool Menthol Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This straightforward replacement pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a clean, icy Menthol flavour. Cool Menthol delivers a crisp, no-frills Menthol experience with an instantly bracing, refreshing chill. With its smooth, cooling sensation and simple flavour profile, it’s an ideal pick for fans of classic, fuss-free, always satisfying menthol vapes. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
